topEvents.text: Strong quakes and aftershocks triggered evacuations across all 10 provinces and two Indigenous territories; 27 injuries reported; shelters opened and national emergency declared.
Five people missing; remote villages cut off after bridges and hydropower sites were damaged; evacuations and airlifted relief ongoing.
At least four deaths; widespread outages; flooding and tornado threats across multiple states; coastal and inland damage with ongoing cleanup and residual flood risk.
Category 3 hurricane impacting coastal and hillside communities; evacuations and suspended classes across 22 municipalities; risk of landslides and flash flooding.
Heavy rain overflowed the Mapocho River; at least six injured; rescues, school closures, and road disruptions reported; several districts on high alert.

outlook72h: Panama - Earthquake Sequence Continued aftershocks likely; prioritize structural safety inspections and cordons around compromised buildings. Sustain shelter operations; monitor for secondary hazards (debris falls, utility instability). Nepal - Budhi Gandaki Corridor Air operations to remain essential while road access is severed; watch for additional slope failures and debris flows. Pre-position food, WASH, and medical kits for isolated hamlets. USA - Hurricane Isaias Aftereffects Residual flooding and difficult travel in saturated river basins; ongoing outage restoration and debris clearance. Localized severe weather possible in trailing bands; maintain readiness for flash-flood watches. Mexico - Hurricane Simon Heavy rain over coastal and mountainous Jalisco may trigger flash floods and landslides; continuity of shelter and class suspensions may be required. Rapid needs assessments in vulnerable hillside settlements once conditions allow. Chile - Central Region Rains Soil saturation elevates mudslide risk on slopes; staged reopening of roads contingent on clearance and inspection. California - Wildfire & Coastal Flooding Wildfire: Evacuation and perimeter stability remain priorities; air quality advisories possible near burn areas. Coast: Additional high waves could renew localized flooding; temporary berms/sandbags to be monitored.
